extraction.Name: Rachel Cilick Snider
extraction.Recorded patent: she gave attention to the paper and found it was a Deed for the above described land and had the same recorded
extraction.Buyer: Mr. Dan Fisher of Vermillion, S.D. bought the land; he gave Mr. Dithmer $9.75 per acre for the half-section; land sold for $3120.00; deponent received $1000.00 from mortgage and $250.00 from sale
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: knowing that I could not pay the interest and taxes on the land I told him that I would sell the land
extraction.NOTES: Borrowed $1000.00 from Northern Trust Co. of Pierre, S.D. on Aug. 9, 1915; husband died in 1915; left business to J.H. Dithmer of Kadoka, S.D.; deponent states she was defrauded in the deal; has three children to support; has been troubled with High Blood Pressure; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since she was granted a patent; land described as N.2 of sec. 1, T.43 R.36; paid Dithmer $50.00 for his services; document notarized April 22, 1920 in County of Washabaugh, State of South Dakota | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Agency" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
